description:
C.8 is now a long single paragraph mixing the ink-testing-library requirement, the no-browser/no-E2E rule, and the requires:operator carve-out; consider splitting into sub-bullets for scanability. Cosmetic only.

acceptanceCriteria: Item 8 of section 'C. Acceptance criteria health' in .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md is reformatted from a single long paragraph into a short lead line followed by sub-bullets, one per concern: (1) UI/Ink stories verified via ink-testing-library (render + assert on actual screen output/glyph); (2) cam-cli has no browser/server/database, so end-to-end tests and any browser-opening check are never applicable and must be flagged; (3) a genuinely interactive ceremony (real TUI keypress only a human can drive) is not solved by that requirement and must be tagged requires: "operator".
No semantic content is added or removed: all three concerns present in the original paragraph survive verbatim in meaning; the change is formatting/scanability only.
templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md is NOT changed (its generic item 8 stays generic).
typecheck and the full test suite pass green, including any doc-gate / check-count / validate-agents-md assertions over the auditor md.
No other item in the auditor md is renumbered or altered.
spec.scope: Cosmetic scanability fix: split the long single-paragraph item C.8 in .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md into a lead line plus one sub-bullet per concern. Touch only .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md. Do NOT touch the generic templates/ copy.
gotchas: The two copies are intentionally NOT identical: .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md is the cam-cli-customized auditor, templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md is the generic scaffold (its item 8 keeps browser+E2E because a generic project may be a web app). Only the .claude copy is in scope.

Verify no check-count / doc-gate / validate-agents-md test asserts C.8 as a single item or matches an inline substring that spans the reformatted text; the sub-bullet split must keep any such assertion green (AC requires the full suite green).
.claude/agents/ is the live runtime agent definition (not embedded via templates/), so this edit needs no embed-vendor regeneration.
